model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the F1 score and the leakage rate for three different methods: Teacher, Self-Training, and PST. The x-axis, labeled "Leakage Rate," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.585, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "F1," is also a linear scale ranging from 52.5 to 72.5, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The Teacher method is represented by a red line with star markers, the Self-Training method by a blue line with square markers, and the PST method by a green line with circle markers. The Teacher method starts with the highest F1 score at 72.5 and shows a steady decline as the leakage rate increases, ending at an F1 score of 55.0. The Self-Training method begins with an F1 score of 70.0 and also declines as the leakage rate increases, ending at an F1 score of 55.0. The PST method starts with an F1 score of 70.0 and follows a similar downward trend, ending at an F1 score of 55.0. All three methods show a decrease in F1 score as the leakage rate increases, with the Teacher and Self-Training methods converging at the same F1 score of 55.0 at a leakage rate of 0.5.
